decisions.decision: Use Python standard-library runtime and supplied CLI/HTTP/SQLite scaffolding, with gaps only in named capabilities.
decisions.why: Avoid imposing HTTPX/Pydantic/async/DuckDB before the beginner can explain parsing, errors and joins; preserve later toolchain routes.

decisions.decision: Add a dedicated small SQL investigation instead of reusing the advanced event ledger.
decisions.why: Existing M8b ledger teaches replay systems, not beginner one-to-many joins, relational grain and reconciliation.

decisions.decision: Retain optional public Weather check, but default to synthetic offline data and tests.
decisions.why: API availability and commercial terms must not block local learning. One mock call never establishes real network availability.
